999008199.text: 着いた……ちゃんと地面だ！
ここが北の果て、オーベンランド……

localizations.en: So this is Obenland, the edge of the north...

999008199.text: わぁー。人が住んでるんすねえ

localizations.en: Wow. People actually live here, huh?

999008199.text:
見た感じ、港に近い玄関口でも家屋はまばら……
つつましい漁村だね

localizations.en: From what I can see, even near the harbor entrance, the houses are few and far between... It looks like a humble fishing village.

999008199.text:
わたしの故郷も小さな漁村でしたけど、
比べものにならないくらい寂れてますね……

localizations.en: My hometown was a small fishing village too, but this place makes it look bustling by comparison...

999008199.text: あっ、第一島民発見！　すみませーん

localizations.en: Oh, there's a villager! Excuse me!

999008199.text:
こりゃ驚いた。
でっかい船……あんたら、外から来た人たちかい

localizations.en: Well, I'll be. That's a big ship... You folks are not from around here, I take it?

999008199.text:
はい！　ノーヴァ神聖国って所から
遥々やって来ました

localizations.en: Yes! We traveled all the way from a place called Nova.

999008199.text:
……？　初めて聞く国だねえ。
ま、たまに来るんだよ。あんたらみたいな物好きが

localizations.en: Nova? Never heard of it. Well, we get visitors like you every now and then. The curious explorer types.

999008199.text: あはは、物好きですみません

見ての通り、この島はなんもないよ。
獲れるのも魚ばかりだが、食べてくかい？

localizations.en: As you can see for yourselves, there's nothing much on this island. All we've got is fish, but you're welcome to stay for a meal if you like.

999008199.text:
食べる！
その土地の名物料理は旅の楽しみよね！

localizations.en: We'll take it! Sampling the local cuisine is one of the joys of traveling!

999008199.text:
それは後にしよう、ヴァレリアが本気を出すと
村の備蓄が底をついてしまうかもしれないし

localizations.en: Perhaps we should save that for later. If Valeria gets serious, the village's entire food supply might be at stake.

999008199.text:
ところで、何もないと仰いますが、
このようなものはありませんか？

localizations.en: By the way, you mentioned that there's nothing much around here, but have you seen anything like this?

999008199.text:
ああ、その石ころかい？
あっちの荒れ地にたくさん転がってるよ

localizations.en: Oh, that sort of rock? There's plenty of those scattered around the wastelands over the yonder.

999008199.text:
やはり……海の果てにほど近いこの地にも
手付かずのマナが眠っている……！

localizations.en: Just as I thought... Even here, at the edge of the sea, untouched mana lies dormant...!

999008199.text:
星から降り注いだマナが、
今なお大量に眠っているといわれている地……

localizations.en: A land where mana that fell from the stars is said to still slumber in vast quantities...

999008199.text: 師匠の言ってた通りだ……！

localizations.en: It's just like Miss Saskia said...!

999008199.text:
何がそんなに嬉しいのかね？
煮ても焼いても食えない石ころなんかが

localizations.en: What's got you so excited? They're just rocks. No matter how you cook 'em, you can't eat 'em.

999008199.text: まあ、錬金術が使えないと意味ないっすもんねえ

localizations.en: Well, they're not very useful to non-alchemists.

999008199.text:
長い船旅をしてでも採掘する価値はある。
ここは本国に連絡を……喜ぶぞ、兄上は

localizations.en: They're definitely worth the long sea voyage to gather. I should contact the capital at once... My brother will be thrilled.

999008199.text:
ロマンさん！　それも大切ですけど！
果ての大陸の伝承についても聞かなくちゃ！

localizations.en: Roman! While that's important, we need to ask about the legends of World's End too!

999008199.text:
果ての大陸ってのは知らないが……
それだったら裏の婆さんに聞いてみたらどうだい？

localizations.en: I don't know anything about World's End... But if you're looking for stories like that, try talking to the old woman out back.

999008199.text:
この村でも一番の古株だからな。
言い伝えなんかには詳しいはずだ

localizations.en: She's been here longer than anyone. If anyone knows, it'll be her.

999008199.text: ほう、果ての大陸……これはまた懐かしい名前を聞いた

localizations.en: Oh my, World's End, you say... Now that's something I haven't heard in ages.

999008199.text: ご存じなんですか！？

多くの宝物が眠る理想郷……
今では、その名を語る者はほとんどおらんがの

localizations.en: They say it's a promised land filled with treasure... These days, hardly anyone speaks of it anymore.

999008199.text:
わしらの先祖たちは、
それを目指してこの場所まで流れ着いたのじゃ

localizations.en: Our ancestors washed ashore here while seeking out that very place.

999008199.text:
そうか。ここオーベンランドには、かつて果ての大陸を
目指した冒険者たちが住みついていたんだ！

localizations.en: I see. So Obenland was settled by adventurers who once sought World's End!

999008199.text: となると、やはりこの先に果ての大陸が……！？

localizations.en: Then World's End really does lie beyond here...?!

999008199.text: 決まりっすね！　補給したら早速北へ――

localizations.en: That settles it! Once we resupply, we head north—

999008199.text: やはりアンタらもか……！　やめなされ……！

localizations.en: You mustn't! Or you'll end up like the others before you...!

999008199.text: え？

これより北は大魔境……「暗黒の氷海」！
命が惜しくば、諦めて引き返すことじゃ

localizations.en: Beyond here lies a cursed expanse—the Midnight Sea! If you value your lives, turn back now while you still can.
